# SPEC 2.5: comptime.SizeOf, AlignOf, and HasPointers equal unsafe.Sizeof,
# unsafe.Alignof, and the garbage collector pointer map of the lowered type on
# the target. The run fixture compares each form with the compiled type on a
# 64-bit and a 32-bit target and builds for arm64.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_layout_forms.lgo a/main.lgo
cd a

env GOARCH=amd64
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_layout_forms.out

env GOARCH=386
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_layout_forms.out

env GOARCH=arm64
logos build -o forms_arm64.exe .

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/layoutforms

go 1.27
